mapper.insert: INSERT INTO odometry_data (robot_id, frame_id, pos_x, pos_y, pos_z, orient_x, orient_y, orient_z, orient_w, timestamp,reception_count) VALUES (#{robotId}, #{frameId}, #{posX}, #{posY}, #{posZ}, #{orientX}, #{orientY}, #{orientZ}, #{orientW}, #{timestamp},#{receptionCount})
